author: ljuckett
body: #### PR description: This PR turns off PS plots and adds 3 new plots for the Cosmic Rack DQM configuration. All new plots are produced for OT clusters. 1) Correlation of local X of clusters in top & bottom sensor of a single module: 2) Number of clusters map: 3) Average cluster size map: Additionally, there is the addition of the CRACKOverview histogram parameters and 2DPoly bins as a template PSet. Eventually, there will be more template PSets (barrel/endcap modulemaps...) using the same function. The Cosmic Rack DQM script now also contains a variable to switch between DATA configuration and MC (however, currently all data is for CMSSW_16, so cannot be run in CMSSW_20 _yet_). #### PR validation: Tested the new configuration script with MC data and (upon copying code back to CMSSW_16) real unpacked data from CRACK. Tested the full tracker configuration to ensure nothing is changed.
title: [DQM] Phase-2 CRack: Add more DQM plots
